messages:
Priya R: Hey team — quick sync. We're ~12 hours from the release window. Need a final pass on SDKs/docs/quickstarts. Who's owning the sampleapp dependency bump? :eyes:
Ben K: I'm on it, bumping express in sampleapp-node. PR #305 is open. CI flaky tests are the only blockers, mostly a timeout on the integration job.
Maya D: I'll take docs. Updating the quickstart auth flow and adding a tiny troubleshooting sect for token rotation. ETA ~2h.
Liam: @Ben K can you add a short note in the changelog about the sampleapp streaming behavior change? Might affect customers using prefix replay.
Ben K: Yep — will add a changelog entry and link the PR. Also tagging @Anna for SDK signing and CI review.
Anna: On review. One nit in token-rotation helper but otherwise LGTM. Can merge after CI pass.
Jordan: FYI deploy bot shows a canary hiccup on non-AMD nodes earlier — likely infra. Looping in eng-infra if needed.
DeployBot: canary-deploy failed: task=9278 exit=1 — log excerpt: 'cuda driver mismatch: required 525.*, found 470.*'
Maya D: Docs update depends on SDK tag. Anna, if you cut the patch, I'll update the quickstart snippets to point to the new version.
Anna: Cutting patch now, bumping SDK 0.9.7 -> 0.9.8, pushing tag + release notes.
Priya R: Two asks: (1) please add final changelog entries to /docs/changelog.md by EOD — leave PR link in this thread; (2) who will run quickstart smoke tests on macOS and Linux?
Liam: I'll run the macOS smoke. 
Ben K: I'll do Linux (ubuntu-22) smoke and verify container image.
Jordan: I'll confirm rollout window with eng-sre — tentatively 16:00 PT, will post final.
Maya D: Added docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/998 — quickstart + troubleshooting updated.
Anna: SDK release PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/211 — tag pushed v0.9.8.
Ben K: Sampleapp PR: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapps/pull/305 — bumped express + CI fix.
Priya R: Great. Action items summary: Anna merge SDK, Ben merge sampleapp, Maya merge docs, Liam + Ben run smokes, Jordan confirm 16:00 PT with SRE. I'll compile final changelog after merges. Ping here when merged :rocket:
Liam: starting macOS smoke now (running quickstart, testing auth + streaming).
Ben K: merging sampleapp in 2m, will trigger container build.
Anna: SDK merged and tag released (v0.9.8).
Maya D: Docs merged, quickstart snippets now reference v0.9.8.
Ben K: Sampleapp merged, images pushed to registry, linux smoke = green.
Liam: macOS smoke = green (no regressions).
Jordan: Confirmed 16:00 PT with eng-sre; they'll monitor canary and metrics.
Priya R: Thanks everyone — I'll post the release summary + consolidated changelog in #general after the window. :tada:
